## Model links

**Diffusion model**

You can use FP8 or GGUF model:

- [qwen_image_edit_2509_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-Edit_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/qwen_image_edit_2509_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors)


- [qwen_image_edit_2509 - GGUF Models](https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-GGUF/tree/main)







**LoRA**

- [Qwen-Image-Lightning-8steps-V2.0.safetensors (You can use 4step)](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Lightning/tree/main)

**Text encoder**

- [qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

**VAE**

- [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-GGUF/tree/main)

Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── qwen_image_edit_2509_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors
│   │   OR
│   │   └── Qwen_Image_Edit_2509-Q6_K.gguf
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── Qwen-Image-Lightning-4steps-V2.0.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── qwen_image_vae.safetensors
│   └── 📂 text_encoders/
│       └── qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
```

optional - conrolnet

Use this for more control, but 
but it is not needed in some cases.

Using it you may lost some character consistancy in rezults

I noticed that sometimes the face can change a lot at the 2nd step. I recommend trying to reduce steps from 2 to 1. (end at step) You will lose the accuracy of the background, but the character will look like himself more often.

Reference latent is optional

It can enhance the preservation of character details, but it often causes an artifact. You can always bypass it.

For simple characters, I recommend disabling it.
Here we inject only the character reference image.
place this character into the image

You can bypass bottom inpaint crop node - qwen will take full image as reference. 

Or use a mask to highlight your reference face.

## Model links

**Diffusion model**

You can use FP8 or GGUF model:

- [FLUX.1-Fill-dev-GGUF - GGUF Models](https://huggingface.co/YarvixPA/FLUX.1-Fill-dev-GGUF/tree/main)

**Text encoder**

- [clip_l.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/blob/main/clip_l.safetensors)

And t5 fp8:

- [t5xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/comfyanonymous/flux_text_encoders/tree/main)

Or t5 gguf:


- [t5xxl.gguf](https://huggingface.co/city96/t5-v1_1-xxl-encoder-gguf/tree/main)




**VAE**

- [ae.safetensors(flux)](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Lumina_Image_2.0_Repackaged/blob/main/split_files/vae/ae.safetensors)

Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── flux-fill-dev-Q8_0.gguf
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── FLUX.1-Turbo-Alpha.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── ae.safetensors
│   └── 📂 clip (or text_encoders)
│       └── t5-v1_1-xxl-encoder-Q8_0.gguf
│   └── 📂 text_encoders
│       └── clip_l.safetensors
```

combine the body from first image with the head from the second image to make one coherent person with correct anatomical proportions. Preserve the lighting, environment and background from the first image.

For best rezults:
1) Upload Images

2) In the first image mask only face and hair
The accuracy of the selection is important!

3) In the reference image, mask only face and hair too. You can use big brush. The accuracy of the selection is NOT important. You do that for proper crop operation.

5) Generate image. 

4) Play with color correction (Сontrol color match strength)
This will help you with many problems with skin color and light

5) Sometimes qwen is very dumb and gives out the wrong face at all. Usually it is enough to change seed 3-4 times and unplug the image 3 controlnet in the bottom text encoder node (the second ksampler) and plug in image2 in all inputs

6) After obtaining a good facial image, you can improve it with the help of flux fill. It will fix all the imperfections quite quickly.
